title: Refuse a version mismatch plainly
description: Sections 5 and 13. A client that speaks only OAL 9.0 is refused with version_mismatch, a message that says which side to update, and close code 4002.

steps.note: A future client: it speaks only 9.0.
version_mismatch (-33001). The message is for people: it names both versions and who should update.
